description: Adds Character DiceSet selector to step_globalbasics
replace:
<xf:if is="$rpgSelectableDiceSets is not empty">
	<xf:selectrow name="{$fieldname}[cv6_rpg_dice_set]"
		value="{{ $char.cv6_rpg_dice_set ?: '' }}"
		label="{{ phrase('cv6_rpg_character_dice_set') }}"
		explain="{{ phrase('cv6_rpg_character_dice_set_explain') }}">
		<xf:option value="">{{ phrase('cv6_rpg_use_account_default_dice_set') }}</xf:option>
		<xf:foreach loop="$rpgSelectableDiceSets" value="$dSet">
			<xf:option value="{$dSet.set_key}">{$dSet.title}</xf:option>
		</xf:foreach>
	</xf:selectrow>
</xf:if>

$0
